title: FW↔FE-001: Firmware-Status Semantics + Device-Management UI Requirements (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED / PROVISIONAL — there is NO direct §6 contract on either the Firmware Engineer or the Frontend/Dashboard Engineer side (FIRMWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no Frontend; FRONTEND_DASHBOARD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no Firmware). Firmware status reaches dashboards via the cloud: Firmware telemetry / OTA state to Backend (FW↔BACK-001), served to the Frontend (BACK↔FE-001). This schema reconstructs the plausible direct interface (firmware-status / device-management semantics ↔ device-management UI requirements) for machine validation; per its x-macp.source_status it mandates a COUNTER. Device-management actions that re-flash or re-key escalate via FW↔BACK-001 / the security baseline.

firmware_status_semantics.description: FW→FE: firmware/device-management status semantics (surfaced via FW↔BACK-001 → BACK↔FE-001).

items.description: e.g., reboot, request-diagnostics (binding actions route through FW↔BACK-001).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Provisional/DERIVED edge — no §6 contract exists on either side; firmware status reaches the dashboard through the Backend (FW↔BACK-001 → BACK↔FE-001). Agents coordinate provisionally and must COUNTER for ratification; binding device-management actions (re-flash, re-key) route through FW↔BACK-001 / the security baseline.
x-macp.source_status: DERIVED — no direct §6 on either the FW or FE side; reconstructed from the mediated path (FW↔BACK-001 / BACK↔FE-001). Mandates COUNTER (CCR to ratify a §6 contract), not a binding CONFIRM.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (provisional — to be set by the ratifying §6 contract / CCR)
confirm_conditions: firmware status fields (OTA state, boot health, version) are defined for display
status reaches the dashboard via the Backend path (FW↔BACK-001 → BACK↔FE-001)

reject_conditions: a device-management action (reboot/re-flash/re-key) wired directly from the UI to firmware bypassing FW↔BACK-001 (security/desired-state path)

counter_conditions: ALWAYS COUNTER: request ratification of a real FW↔FE §6 contract (or confirm the relationship is intentionally mediated via Backend) via a CCR before any binding CONFIRM
a UI control implies a privileged device action — route it through the Backend desired-state contract (FW↔BACK-001) with the security review
